india.one_line: Nvidia funds Simplismart, IT firms target enterprise AI, and Defence Ministry partners with Sarvam for AI.

themes.title: Nvidia backs Simplismart startup
themes.text: Nvidia led a $14 million Series B round valuing Simplismart at $100 million, citing its software cut GPU serving costs by 56%.

stories.headline: Nvidia backs Indian startup Simplismart with $14 million to cut AI GPU costs

themes.title: Indian IT firms eye enterprise AI services
themes.text: A report says Indian IT companies can profit from enterprise AI by offering asset‑light services as AI infrastructure costs rise.

stories.headline: Indian IT firms positioned to profit from enterprise AI as infrastructure costs rise

themes.title: Defence ministry signs AI partnership
themes.text: The Ministry of Defence signed a five‑year MoU with Sarvam AI to develop decision‑support, target acquisition and data‑fusion tools for the armed forces.

stories.headline: India's Ministry of Defence signs AI partnership with Sarvam
